title: Classify and fix the invented reminder title
goal: Classify the failure (prompt, plan validation or model choice), fix it with a failing case first, and measure the frozen case in an owner-approved rerun
acceptance: A request without a title gets a question in the request's language, never an invented title
A deterministic guard, if chosen, is covered by a failing-first test
The frozen case is rerun within the owner-approved budget and its rate recorded
privacy: Neutral repository fixtures; real-model reruns only on loopback Ollama within the owner's approval, no cloud route or paid usage
escalation: Stop at the approved budget (12 invocations, 60 minutes of model time)
A prompt or model change beyond this case goes to the owner

effort.basis: Added 2026-11-12 at the harness 6.0.0 reconcile, which gives every record a step: the record's own Small estimate (classification, a guard or prompt change with tests, an owner-approved rerun) in agent hours, judged at the NERV rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day plus review and CI; model time of the rerun not counted. Estimate, not a measurement. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 2 h → 1.25 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept.
